run_vq_diffusion_pipeline: run the VQDiffusionPipeline to generate images from text prompts using discrete diffusion
encode_prompt_with_clip: encode text prompts into normalized CLIP embeddings using the _encode_prompt method
truncate_log_probabilities: truncate log probabilities so cumulative probability stays below a given truncation rate
create_learnable_embeddings: create a LearnedClassifierFreeSamplingEmbeddings instance with learnable parameters for classifier free sampling
configure_vq_diffusion: configure the VQDiffusionPipeline with a vqvae, transformer, scheduler, and CLIP text encoder
